 Follow Bigger Tax Refunds: IRS Tax Credits Claimed by Tens of Millions of Filers Worth More in 2027
 SILive.com Mon, November 9, 2026 at 7:34 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Internal Revenue Service says the Child Tax Credit and Earned Income Tax Credit will increase in 2027, for taxes filed in 2028. The Child Tax Credit rises from $2,200 to $2,300 per child, with the refundable portion increasing to $1,800. That refundable portion can be paid back even when no taxes are owed. Income limits and child eligibility rules apply. For the Earned Income Tax Credit, the maximum for families with three or more qualifying children increases to $8,496.
